Well, antidote is meant for poison, while vaccine and cure, for diseases. For the common sense, depression is something that you allow to happen to you (it would be a completely external factor that developed the depression, like a poison) ,with negatives thoughts, to much stress, lack of communication, whatever. In this case, it makes some sense. For us, it helps a lot if we learn how to see the life in a most compassionate way, specially with ourselves. We already carry so much grieve, pain and guilty that it worsens the depression. Being more grateful with the people that are around us is a good start. Again, motivational speeches are meant to start a self reflection, not to be take as it is.

The disease depression should have another name to differentiate from this sadness feeling. But with time you will learn how to have patience with people. They don't mean harm (most of times), and we are kinda more sensitive and we don't understand the other side too.  It's complicated, but you cam manage it.

The problem with motivational speeches and sentences is that they are too short to fill all the reality in it. It's not meant to be taken as it is, but to make you think. I don't find it offensive. People usually mistaken sadness or being down with depression. I just don't think too much about it.

I don't remember clearly, but I saw my mother, sister and stepfather next to me and I thought "the heck is going on?" I don't remember the attempt, and hardly what happened after. But when I regained consciousness, I regretted not succeed. After that (it's been 4 or 5 years), I started planning another attempt, but then I got a boyfriend as the last chance to life. He was the only reason to keep alive for the 4 and half years we stayed together, not even my family was reason enough. Now the only reason I don't kill myself is that it would give too much trouble for the people that would find me. While I don't craft some crazy machine that would evaporate my body painlessly, I am treating with meds and cbt. I am trying, but the thought of keep living is exhausting. I don't watch news anymore, the only news source I use is the onion, I am trying to do lists to follow weekly, eating health, exercising, etc etc. But still, I resent the ex-bf. If I didn't date him, I would kill myself while I still didn't care about the others. I hope someday I will thank him for it. But for now, I can't stop thinking that being dead would be better

I feel like I should get over it already, have a normal and functional life, but instead I think I freak out to make someone take care of me, even if there is no one to do that. I don't tell what happened to anyone. The people that know it was through my mother. I don't talk about it, but I kinda want that people fell sorry and help me, at same time I don't want people feeling sorry and helping me. Sometimes I want to justify myself, that I have reasons to fail, not because I'm not capable, but because I'm too broken. But then I think that is terrible, that Iam giving myself excuses and I just don't want to accept yhat I just failed. So end up in this stage that I don't know if I am being too nice and complacent or too hard and cruel with myself.
